note: Public verification material for OVL issuer-signed receipts. The issuer signature attests ORIGIN only (a receipt signed by the holder of this issuer key); it is NOT non-repudiation, authorization, mandate-binding, legal admissibility, correctness, or tamper-proofing. The primary proof of every receipt is KEYLESS: recompute content_hash with ovl_verifier.py (stdlib only, no key needed). The signature is an additive origin/attributability layer, not the core guarantee.
